description: Groceries, insurance, housing — the cost of just getting by in Louisiana's 3rd District keeps climbing, and paychecks aren't keeping up. That's not a talking point. It's what I hear at every kitchen table, every church parking lot, every parish I visit.Affordability is my top priority because it touches every family in this district, no matter their politics. Here's where I stand: fight to lower the cost of groceries, insurance, and housing; support wages that actually keep pace with today's eco
title: Affordability Is the Fight
